intro.text: An elderly, one-armed Veden veteran, the sole survivor of his platoon.

items.text: Dalinar met Geved among the sole survivors in a field hospital in Vedenar. Geved had fought Dalinar's army at Slickrock and had always wanted to meet the Blackthorn. Asked about the civil war, he grew agitated: it was unlike any battle he had seen, the soldiers driven by bloodlust. Listening, Dalinar felt the Thrill and realised it had come to Vedenar.

appearance.text: Elderly, missing his right arm, with a stare that seems to go through you; he wears a clean uniform bearing his lost platoon's patch.

personality.text: Respects the art of war as a way of life and remembers his battles fondly.
